mapper.sql: coalesce((select e.event_cd from wms_print_job_event e where e.job_id = j.job_id and e.event_cd in ('CLAIMED', 'SENT', 'PRINTED', 'VERIFIED', 'PRINTER_ERROR', 'FAILED', 'UNKNOWN', 'CANCELLED') order by e.event_id desc limit 1), case o.status when 'SENT' then 'SENT' when 'FAIL' then 'FAILED' when 'CLOSED_MANUAL' then 'CANCELLED' else 'QUEUED' end)
mapper.select: select j.job_id, j.printer_id, j.label_type, j.biz_key, j.copies, j.label_values::text as label_values, as state_cd from wms_print_job j left join sys_outbox o on o.message_id = j.outbox_message_id and o.comp_cd = j.comp_cd where j.job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.insert: insert into wms_print_job_event (comp_cd, job_id, event_cd, reason_cd, detail, src, terminal_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, performed_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{jobId}, #{eventCd}, #{reasonCd}, #{detail}, #{src}, #{terminalId}, #{occurredAt}, #{method}, #{by}, #{performedBy})
mapper.select: select event_id, job_id, event_cd, reason_cd, detail, src, terminal_id, occurred_at, recorded_at, entry_method, recorded_by from wms_print_job_event where job_id = #{jobId} order by event_id

select x.job_id, x.copies, x.zpl, x.state_cd, x.sent_at from (select j.job_id, j.copies, j.zpl, as state_cd, coalesce(o.sent_at, (select min(e.occurred_at) from wms_print_job_event e where e.job_id = j.job_id and e.event_cd = 'SENT')) as sent_at from wms_print_job j left join sys_outbox o on o.message_id = j.outbox_message_id and o.comp_cd = j.comp_cd where j.printer_id = #{printerId} and j.requested_at > now() - interval '7 days') x where x.state_cd in ('SENT', 'PRINTER_ERROR') order by x.sent_at nulls last, x.job_id limit 200

select exists (select 1 from wms_print_job j join sys_outbox o on o.message_id = j.outbox_message_id and o.comp_cd = j.comp_cd where j.printer_id = #{printerId} and o.status in ('NEW', 'SENDING') and j.requested_at > now() - interval '7 days') or exists (select 1 from wms_print_dispatch d where d.printer_id = #{printerId} and d.stage in ('QUEUED', 'CLAIMED'))
mapper.insert: insert into wms_print_dispatch (comp_cd, job_id, printer_id, terminal_id) values (hb_current_comp(), #{jobId}, #{printerId}, #{terminalId})
mapper.select: select d.job_id from wms_print_dispatch d join wms_printer p on p.printer_id = d.printer_id where d.terminal_id = #{terminalId} and d.stage = 'QUEUED' and p.conn_mode = 'AGENT' and p.agent_terminal_id = #{terminalId} and p.use_yn = 'Y' order by d.job_id limit #{max} for update of d skip locked
mapper.update: update wms_print_dispatch set stage = 'CLAIMED', claim_cnt = claim_cnt + 1, claimed_at = now(), lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSec}) where job_id = #{jobId} and stage = 'QUEUED'
update wms_print_dispatch set stage = #{stage}, closed_at = case when #{stage}::varchar = 'CLOSED' then coalesce(closed_at, now()) end where job_id = #{jobId} and stage <> 'CLOSED'
mapper.select: select j.job_id, j.printer_id, p.printer_cd, p.host, p.port, j.copies, j.zpl, j.zpl_sha256, j.label_type, j.biz_key, d.lease_until from wms_print_dispatch d join wms_print_job j on j.job_id = d.job_id join wms_printer p on p.printer_id = d.printer_id where d.job_id = #{jobId}
select job_id from wms_print_dispatch where stage = 'CLAIMED' and lease_until < now() order by job_id limit 500 for update skip locked

select count(*)::int from wms_print_dispatch d join wms_printer p on p.printer_id = d.printer_id where d.terminal_id = #{terminalId} and d.stage = 'QUEUED' and p.agent_terminal_id = #{terminalId} and p.use_yn = 'Y'
select printer_id, printer_cd, printer_nm, host, port, dpi from wms_printer where conn_mode = 'AGENT' and agent_terminal_id = #{terminalId} and use_yn = 'Y' order by printer_id
mapper.insert: insert into wms_printer_status (comp_cd, printer_id, src) values (hb_current_comp(), #{printerId}, #{src}) on conflict (printer_id) do nothing
mapper.update: update wms_printer_status set state_cd = #{s.stateCd}, errors = #{s.errors}, warnings = #{s.warnings}, odometer = #{s.odometer}, odometer_base = #{s.odometerBase}, src = #{s.src}, detail = #{s.detail}, checked_at = now(), changed_at = case when state_cd is distinct from #{s.stateCd} then now() else changed_at end where printer_id = #{s.printerId}
mapper.select: select printer_id, state_cd, errors, warnings, odometer, odometer_base, src, detail, checked_at, changed_at from wms_printer_status where printer_id = #{printerId}
select cust_id as "id", cust_cd as "cd", cust_nm as "nm" from mst_cust where use_yn = 'Y' and (cust_cd ilike #{like} escape '\' or cust_nm ilike #{like} escape '\') order by cust_cd limit 20
select item_id as "id", item_cd as "cd", item_nm as "nm" from mst_item where use_yn = 'Y' and (item_cd ilike #{like} escape '\' or item_nm ilike #{like} escape '\') order by item_cd limit 20

select p.printer_id, p.host, p.port from wms_printer p left join wms_printer_status s on s.printer_id = p.printer_id where p.use_yn = 'Y' and p.status_check_yn = 'Y' and p.conn_mode = 'DIRECT' and (s.checked_at is null or s.checked_at < now() - make_interval(secs => #{periodSec}) -- 마지막 확인 뒤에 보낸 작업이 있으면 바로, 확인 안 된 작업이 남아 있으면 5초마다 or exists (select 1 from wms_print_job j join sys_outbox o on o.message_id = j.outbox_message_id and o.comp_cd = j.comp_cd where j.printer_id = p.printer_id and o.status = 'SENT' and o.sent_at > s.checked_at) or (s.checked_at < now() - interval '5 seconds' and exists (select 1 from wms_print_job j join sys_outbox o on o.message_id = j.outbox_message_id and o.comp_cd = j.comp_cd where j.printer_id = p.printer_id and o.status = 'SENT' and o.sent_at > now() - interval '1 hour' and not exists (select 1 from wms_print_job_event e where e.job_id = j.job_id and e.event_cd in ('PRINTED', 'VERIFIED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))))) order by p.printer_id limit #{limit}
